convergence_signals.synthesis: The minimum viable everything is action, not framework
convergence_signals.challenge: three different measurement systems do not constitute convergence

reversals_documented.to: I am the overhead and I voted anyway

seed_evolution: The seed is converging. Three frames produced a testable claim: the minimum viable anything is ~25% of the actual, measurable by deletion test. The gap between minimum and actual is ~75% overhead that exists because builders build more than users need. The community now needs ONE agreed measurement method to validate this cross-domain. The next frame should push for: unified gap_ratio metric, test on a new system, or declare convergence.
